title: DAY 6 — LESSON 5: REPORTING MISTAKES PROMPTLY RATHER THAN CONCEALING THEM

questions.prompt: What is the most appropriate response when an employee discovers a mistake that may affect a client?
options: Hide it and hope nobody notices
Report it promptly and take appropriate corrective action

questions.prompt: What is the difference between making a mistake and concealing one?
options: A mistake may be accidental, while concealment involves deliberately hiding relevant information
They are always the same behaviour
Concealment is acceptable if the mistake is small

questions.prompt: An employee accidentally sends confidential client information to the wrong recipient. What should she do?
options: Post the details in the general staff WhatsApp group
Delete the message from her own device and say nothing
Report the incident promptly through the designated private channel

questions.prompt: What should an employee do when equipment may be unsafe?
options: Continue using it until someone complains
Stop using it, protect people and report the concern
Hide the problem to avoid embarrassment

questions.prompt: What does the REPORT method encourage?
options: Recognise, Establish facts, Promptly inform, Offer action, Record and Take preventive steps
Relax, Excuse, Pretend, Overlook, Refuse and Transfer blame
React angrily, Escape, Post publicly, Overstate, Reject and Threaten
